svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Socket: 120 mm of 139.7 x 4 mm tube. Three 10.5 mm holes 60 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below its top, 120 degrees apart, one toward the kerb; weld an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap: 140 x 140 x 6 mm plate, welded on top of the socket all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cheeks: two from 6 mm plate, 96 mm wide, cut to the outline in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right view (top edge sloped at 30 degrees), standing on the cap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with their inside faces 110 mm apart; weld both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each cheek: a 10.5 mm pivot hole, and a tilt slot 10.5 mm wide on a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 mm radius round the pivot, 20 degrees long (chain drill, file).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clean the welds; galvanize or prime and paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the socket slides over the post top until the cap sits on it;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: three M10 set screws centre and lock it. The rails bolt to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the cheeks are parallel and square to the cap.
